resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: hardening checklist: filters of a foreign format accept exactly the receiver grammar
body:
Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md gains a receiver-grammar class: code that skips or accepts lines of a format owned by another tool (packed-refs, git refnames, TAP, CI summaries) accepts exactly what that tool accepts, and its tests cross-check each case against the real tool (e.g. git check-ref-format).
Evidence: PR #222 (t-ca75c7w) spent review attempts 1-3 on the packed-refs filter grammar (OID length, refnames Git rejects, Unicode whitespace); each finding was a grammar mismatch with git, surfaced one per attempt by the prepass.
Proof: the hardening checklist rule test lists the new class; krn brief check refuses a Hardening section without it.
